ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel values (black/dark grey) across >98% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the median notch and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation field. A single contiguous high-contrast white blob is located at the inner margin of the left lobe adjacent to the median notch. Secondary sparse white point-clusters are localized at the extreme lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 40 degrees; depth is significant, extending approximately 10% of total lobe height into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and asymmetric serration. The left lobe inner margin features a deep, non-uniform indentation. Both lobes exhibit secondary low-amplitude (1-5 pixel depth) jagged peaks and valleys along the remaining boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves along both trailing edges, tapering to sharp, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular white pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) concentrated on the extreme lateral margins of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, faint vertical linear disruption of light pixels is visible on the central-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch/tissue loss area on the trailing edge of the left lobe, positioned between the median notch and the mid-lobe section.
